licensingDeviation.statement: The original uses Untitled Sans (Klim) and Aeonik Pro (CoType), both commercial. The clone self-hosts metric-matched substitutes together with the ORIGINAL's own local(Arial) metric-override @font-face blocks, so every numeric type value matches exactly and only glyph-level text-run widths differ (measured 0.1-13px).
licensingDeviation.swapGuidance: A licence purchase is a TOKEN change only: replace the `family` in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json#families and the matching @font-face src. No component or section contract references a font file directly.

metricOverrides.provenance: copied verbatim from the original stylesheet
copied verbatim from the original stylesheet

noExternalRequests.rule: Every font is served from a local path under public/fonts/. No Google Fonts, no CDN. The clone renders fully offline.
